name: Morten Christensen
quote: I had the pleasure of working during my time at Umbraco. While we worked on different teams, we collaborated quite a bit. I also followed Warren's work before joining Umbraco in 2011.
We have always had a good relationship, and I always enjoyed working with Warren who is super friendly and welcoming.

Warren is nothing short of a legend within the Umbraco community, because of his countless contributions through Community work and because of the DevRel work he has done over the years. Warren has helped an enormous amount of developers learn Umbraco - both as newcomers and as seasoned developers who are learning about new features.

I can't think of many other people who, like Warren, has had such an immense impact on Umbraco - growing the product and the community around it. I'm pretty sure you could ask anyone in the Umbraco community and they'd all know who Warren is.

Warren has deep technical knowledge about web development from both a frontend and backend perspective. He strives to simplify the experience for developers working with the product for which he advocates (in this case - Umbraco).
Warren is a learner and a teacher, which makes him an exceptional DevRel person / Developer Advocate.
I would highly recommend Warren as a colleague. If I had the opportunity to hire him, I would do so in a heartbeat.
